meta.title: SAID IN KOREAN · Learn Korean online
meta.description: Learn Korean online with General Korean A1–C2 and TOPIK preparation courses, an optional level quiz, coaching and Speaking Chat.

home.title: Learn Korean with online courses
home.lede: Choose General Korean or TOPIK preparation. New learners can start with a free alphabet course; the level quiz is optional.

paths.title: Find your way into Korean
paths.lede: Start with the alphabet, build your Korean step by step, or prepare for TOPIK. Explore the path that fits your goal.
paths.pending: Course description awaiting the teacher’s approval.

free.title: Learn Hangul for free.
free.name: Free alphabet course
free.body: Learn to read and write the Korean alphabet. The recommended first step for complete beginners, before General Korean A1.
free.materials: Materials in English and German are being prepared.
free.how: Free for everyone. No account and no payment: the course opens directly.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.for: Complete beginners. If Hangul is new to you, start with the free alphabet course.
levels.about: By the end of the course, learners can introduce themselves and describe people, things and places with basic sentence patterns. They use the core particles, talk about past, present and future events, tell the time and dates, count with both number systems, and link sentences with “and”, “so” and “but”.

topik.title: TOPIK preparation
topik.for: Learners preparing for the official TOPIK test.
topik.note: Courses I–VI are our school’s preparation pathway and working names. The official TOPIK exam has two tests: TOPIK I (levels 1–2) and TOPIK II (levels 3–6).

quiz.title: Find your starting point.
quiz.body: Take the optional Korean level quiz. It checks reading, listening and writing across six levels and suggests where you could begin.
